title: Land Encroachment along boundary wall in Aluva
description: Neighbour has constructed a shed exceeding our registered boundary and blocked natural rainwater drainage. We have title deed and survey map from 2018.
preferredCourt: High Court of Kerala / District Court

aiTriage.summary: Prima facie real estate & immovable property issue within Ernakulam. Discovered potential violations regarding title verification and boundaries.
applicableActs: Specific Relief Act, 1963 (Section 5 & 6 for recovery of possession)
Indian Telegraph Act, 1885 (Section 10/16 if utility lines involved)
suggestedRemedies: Issue formal statutory Legal Notice to adversary prior to institution of suit
File Suit for Permanent Prohibitory Injunction before the Munsiff Court
Apply for Advocate Commissioner inspection to prepare mahazar and sketch
aiTriage.estimatedCourtFee: ₹1,500 - ₹5,000 as per Kerala Court Fees and Suits Valuation Act, 1959

title: Drawing 110kV Transmission Line Across Rubber Plantation Without Prior Notice
description: KSEB contractors entered agricultural property in Kanjirappally Village and initiated tree clearing for 110kV overhead line without serving mandatory notice under Section 10/16 of Telegraph Act.

aiTriage.summary: Violates procedural protections under Indian Telegraph Act 1885 and Kerala High Court ruling in Valsamma v. KSEB. Unilateral entry without District Magistrate order under Section 16 is actionable.
applicableActs: Article 226 of the Constitution of India
suggestedRemedies: File Urgent Writ Petition (Civil) seeking interim stay on tree felling
Serve legal notice to Executive Engineer, Transmission Division
Apply for District Court determination of land diminution and yield loss compensation
